evidence: At x=-2,-1,0,1,2 the value is 1; at x=3 it is 121; at x=-7/4 it is 4489/1024; at x=4/9 it is 139129/59049, yielding 16 signed affine rational points plus infinity.
For genus 2 and p=7, the classical Coleman bound under rank<g gives #C(Q)<=#C(F7)+2g-2=16; 17 exhibited points contradict rank<=1, hence rank J(Q)>=2.
